elsewhere.note: He went in to Hagar, and she conceived. When she saw that she had conceived, her mistress was despised in her eyes.
She said to her mistress, “I wish that my lord were with the prophet who is in Samaria! Then he would heal him of his leprosy.”
Behold, as the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a maid to the hand of her mistress; so our eyes look to Yahweh, our God, until…
for an unloved woman when she is married, and a servant who is heir to her mistress.
